hypothesis: The historical direct-frequency head failed because 16 sampled frames underdetermined 128 real coefficient fields per pixel; supervising all 401 stored frames removes that null space and is memory-feasible on one RTX 4090 D.
expected_mechanism: With the complete stored time axis, the fixed Fourier synthesis matrix has full column rank for the first 64 rFFT bins. The full-frame squared field objective is Parseval-equivalent to supervising those complex coefficients, while inference remains a neural U-Net followed by a fixed inverse temporal transform.
conceptual_variable: training frames per record increase from 16 to all 401; architecture, direct 64-bin representation, data families, optimizer family, and loss form remain the historical G2 direct-frequency setup

deployment_contract.output: 401x201x201 neural prediction materialized by fixed Fourier synthesis

evidence_scope.records: one deterministic record from each of uniform, layered, and marmousi

primary_metric: finite one-update full-401 objective and gradients
failure_signals: non-finite loss, gradient, parameter, or prediction
peak allocated CUDA memory greater than 23.5 GiB
rollback: Preserve R7C and all A3/B2-H/Helmholtz checkpoints; reject the full-frame direct-frequency parameterization without launching a long run if this memory probe fails.
